Package com.eloview.sdk.memoryManager

Class Memory

java.lang.Object
com.eloview.sdk.consts.Consts
com.eloview.sdk.accountManager.AccountManager
com.eloview.sdk.memoryManager.Memory
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Memory extends AccountManager
Memory class provides information regarding the device memory. It provides the following operation
  • A method to provide information about the device memory, such as the total memory on the device, the available memory on the device, and whether the device is running low on memory or not. getMemoryInfo
  • A method to read system property readSystemProperty

    • getMemoryInfo

      public org.json.JSONObject getMemoryInfo()
      This method is used to provide information regarding the device memory such as the total (totalMemory) and available memory (availMemory) on the device, along with a boolean value which indicates whether the device is running low on memory (lowMemory) or not. This info is provided in json format.
      Returns:
      json object containing the totalMemory, availMemory, and lowMemory
